name: sky-city-courses
description: Let Claude build Hot Wheels-style race courses in the Sky City game while you watch.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Sky City game on this Mac. With the game's Course Builder open and its LLM link switched on, Claude can read the course guide, lay track pieces (loops, jumps, banked curves, splits), save and load courses, and start a race against AI cars. It only talks to the game on this computer (127.0.0.1) and only edits courses: no files, no internet.
